Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Initial private AutoBuy deployment. Added editable gear keyword rules, a configurable max unit price, max purchases per run, optional HQ inclusion, and a supervised manually-started Market Board buying workflow.
